answer: New identities start on a small trade island of just 6 vetted partners, cut off from the open ocean of the wider market. The island gate opens only after 20 clean deliveries, each signed by a different islander, forming a verifiable thread of trust. Crossing to the ocean needs that thread plus a 25-unit bond, forfeited if any link is forged. A Sybil swarm strands itself: 100 fakes need 2,000 real deliveries and 2,500 units in bonds, yet can trade only among themselves until they earn genuine mainland trust.
